api_key.description: Administrator API key. Falls back to MACO_API_KEY.

ca_file.description: PEM file with extra CA certificates to trust, for a maco server behind a private CA. Falls back to MACO_CA_FILE.

endpoint.description: Maco server URL, optionally ending in /api. Falls back to MACO_ENDPOINT.

job_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wait per asynchronous job. Defaults to 1800 seconds.

block.description: Manage maco resources through its authenticated HTTP API.

address.description: Host IPv4 CIDR on a bridge. Does not configure guest addressing.

members.description: Host interfaces to join to a native bridge.

mode.description: bridge, switch, vmnet-bridged, user, or vlan. Defaults to bridge. Changes replace the network.

name.description: Network name. Changes replace the network.

parent.description: Parent host interface for vlan mode.

tag.description: VLAN ID for vlan mode, 1 to 4094.

vlans.description: VLAN interfaces to create and join to a native bridge.

block.description: A maco host network that VMs attach to. Name and mode changes replace it; other settings update in place.

addresses.description: Static IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR addresses for the primary interface, used by guest provisioning. On a VM, changes update the stored guest setup in place; the guest applies it the next time it runs provisioning (Flatcar after flatcar-reset), from a VM started by maco after the change.

cpus.description: Virtual CPUs, at least 1. Defaults to 2.

disk_size_gib.description: Primary disk size in GiB, at least 1. Defaults to 20.

name.description: Disk name, unique within the VM.

disks.description: Additional data disks matched by name. On a VM they are added, grown, and removed in place; removal destroys the disk.

gateway.description: Primary interface gateway IP address. On a VM, changes update the stored guest setup in place; the guest applies it the next time it runs provisioning (Flatcar after flatcar-reset), from a VM started by maco after the change.

guest_data.description: Raw cloud-init, or Butane for ignition. maco expands [[ ]] placeholders from the VM. Stored in state; protect the state backend. On a VM, changes update the stored guest setup in place; the guest applies it the next time it runs provisioning (Flatcar after flatcar-reset), from a VM started by maco after the change.

guest_provisioner.description: Guest provisioner: none (the default), cloud-init, or ignition. On a VM, changes update the stored guest setup in place; the guest applies it the next time it runs provisioning (Flatcar after flatcar-reset), from a VM started by maco after the change.

hostname.description: Guest hostname for provisioning. Empty uses the VM name. On a VM, changes update the stored guest setup in place; the guest applies it the next time it runs provisioning (Flatcar after flatcar-reset), from a VM started by maco after the change.

image.description: Image key from the maco catalog or media ID.

memory_mib.description: Memory in MiB, at least 64. Defaults to 2048.

name.description: Unique template name, an RFC 1123 hostname.

nameservers.description: DNS server IP addresses for guest provisioning. On a VM, changes update the stored guest setup in place; the guest applies it the next time it runs provisioning (Flatcar after flatcar-reset), from a VM started by maco after the change.

network.description: Primary interface network UUID, or user for NAT (the default). On a VM, changes move the primary interface in place, hotplugged when running; the guest keeps its own address configuration.

block.description: A saved maco machine profile used to pre-fill VM creation. Changing it does not affect VMs already created from it.

gateway.description: Primary interface gateway IP address. On a VM, changes update the stored guest setup in place; the guest applies it the next time it runs provisioning (Flatcar after flatcar-reset), from a VM started by maco after the change.

On a VM, changes update the stored guest setup in place; the guest applies it the next time it runs provisioning (Flatcar after flatcar-reset), from a VM started by maco after the change.

hostname.description: Guest hostname for provisioning. Empty uses the VM name. On a VM, changes update the stored guest setup in place; the guest applies it the next time it runs provisioning (Flatcar after flatcar-reset), from a VM started by maco after the change.

image.description: Image key from the maco catalog or media ID. Changes replace the VM.

mac_address.description: MAC address of the primary interface, stable for the life of the VM.

memory_mib.description: Memory in MiB, at least 64. Defaults to 2048.

name.description: VM name. Changes replace the VM.

nameservers.description: DNS server IP addresses for guest provisioning. On a VM, changes update the stored guest setup in place; the guest applies it the next time it runs provisioning (Flatcar after flatcar-reset), from a VM started by maco after the change.

network.description: Primary interface network UUID, or user for NAT (the default). On a VM, changes move the primary interface in place, hotplugged when running; the guest keeps its own address configuration.

running.description: Desired power state, false by default. Setting false force-stops the VM; shut down the guest first if needed.

block.description: A maco virtual machine created from an image. Destroying it deletes its managed storage.

address.description: Host address on the bridge, if any.

block.description: Look up an existing maco network by name without managing it.
